messages.subject: featureCounts and samtools view counting result in different counts
messages.subject_clean: featureCounts and samtools view counting result in different counts
messages.body_plain:
I used featureCounts and samtools as follow:

featureCounts --minReadOverlap 1 -Q 1 -T 12 -a matrix_gene_protein_coding.saf -F SAF -O -o $OUT/total_counts.txt sort.bam

samtools view -c -q 1 -F 4 -L matrix_gene_protein_coding.bed sort.bam

FeatureCounts produces  a file with the number of reads assigned and in fact the number of counted reads by featureCounts and samtools view (it uses 1 bp overlap) differ a bit.

Why could it happen?

messages.subject_clean: featureCounts and samtools view counting result in different counts
messages.body_plain:
You specified '-O' option in your featureCounts command, which instructed featureCounts to assign each read to all their overlapping genes, ie a read might be counted more than once.

There might be other factors contributing to this discrepancy as well. If you can provide an example to show what exactly the difference is, I can then give more comments.

I sum the number of reads from .txt file for one sample (11901018), the number is much higher than the number display in .summary (assigned: 10985944, unassigned:23131158),  meaning that the parameter -O worked. Also, if I sum assigned and unassigned 10985944 + 23131158 =34117102 and it is exactly my library size identified by samtools as well.

 Samtools showed me for the defined regions: 11050798 and the total (mapped) library size: 34117102

>  to assign each read to all their overlapping genes, ie a read might be counted more than once.

So, in the .summary file the displayed number of reads might depict not the real number of assigned reads, right?
It means, that in .summary only some reads (that overlap multiple features) are counted more then once and other reads (that also overlap multiple features) are not counted twice. But still I would expect the number of assigned reads in .summary to be higher then identified by samtools.

Assigned 7617

samtools view -c -q 1 -F 4 -L ../matrix_gene_protein_coding.bed K27ac_WEN1_ch1_reg.sort.bam

Samtools output is still 7615.

and

HWI-ST227:399:C4Y0RACXX:4:2305:16169:29031      16      chr1    6204644 255     50M     *       0       0       CGCCCGTCCGGCCAGCCCAGCGACTTCCGGATCTGCGCAGACACCTGAGT      DDDDFHJJIHIJJJJJJJJJJJIJJJJJJJJJJJJJJHHHHHDFFFFCCC      XA:i:0  MD:Z:50 NM:i:0

You can turn on the '-R' option in featureCounts to see the assignment result for each individual read.

Best wishes,

Wei

messages.subject: Major release - version 1.5.0
messages.body_plain:
Dear all,

We have just made a new release of Subread package - version 1.5.0.

This is a major release that includes a lot of improvements to read mapping and quantification programs. See Subread home page for release note and latest version of software:

http://subread.sourceforge.net/

Please let us know if your encounter any problems or have any suggestions!

Best wishes,

Yang and Wei

messages.subject: Re: Change to allow for samtools sorting?
messages.subject_clean: Change to allow for samtools sorting?
messages.body_plain:
featureCounts can now use multiple threads to speed up read re-sorting. It takes only half a minute to re-sort 30 million read pairs with 8 threads.

A new utility program 'repair' is also included in the new release (v1.5.0) and it can be used to pre-sort paired-end bam reads (re-sorted reads are saved to a bam file). The generated bam file will not need to be re-sorted by featureCounts.

Wei
